resources.string: Stereo mixes surround tracks down to two channels in the player. Try it if dialogue keeps getting louder and quieter on a TV or soundbar. Auto uses the layout your system's audio output is set to.
No devices found. The TV or player must be on, on the same network, and have DLNA (media sharing / UPnP) enabled. If your system runs a firewall, it must also let Nuvio reach the local network.
Needs ffmpeg on this PC. Install it with your distribution's package manager.
Not available in the Flatpak version, whose sandbox cannot run your system's ffmpeg.

Nuvio cannot start this .desktop file: it is missing, is not a game entry, or runs through a shell or another launcher.
You still confirm each update. When on, Nuvio replaces the AppImage or installs the .deb itself; when off, it saves the file to your Downloads folder.

Opens Google's real sign-in page in a temporary window of a browser installed on this PC: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Vivaldi, Opera or Firefox. Sign in there, wait for YouTube Music to load, then close the window; Nuvio then reads the session cookies and deletes the temporary profile. They are sent only for videos YouTube blocks without an account, and Nuvio never sees your password. A secondary Google account is safest.
